# Nirantara

> Cloud-native platforms, built in the open

Declarative Kubernetes lifecycle, read-only database MCP servers, and a Kubernetes operator for AI infrastructure.

## Table of Contents

### Documentation

- [Documentation](/docs.md): Documentation for Nirantara's open-source projects: k3sctl, mssql-mcp-go, postgres-mcp-go, and omniroute-operator.

#### k3sctl

- [k3sctl](/docs/k3sctl.md): Declarative lifecycle management for K3s clusters over SSH — install, upgrade, reconfigure, back up, and reset from one YAML file.
- [Installation](/docs/k3sctl/installation.md): Install k3sctl from a release binary, with Go, or build it from source.
- [Configuration](/docs/k3sctl/configuration.md): The k3sctl Cluster file — hosts, roles, SSH access, K3s settings, drain options, and additional manifests.
- [Commands](/docs/k3sctl/commands.md): The k3sctl CLI — apply, reset, kubeconfig, backup, config, init, and more.

#### mssql-mcp-go

- [mssql-mcp-go](/docs/mssql-mcp-go.md): A read-only Model Context Protocol server for Microsoft SQL Server, written in Go, with 70+ tools for schema, data, performance, security, and migration analysis.
- [Installation](/docs/mssql-mcp-go/installation.md): Install mssql-mcp-go with Homebrew, a release binary, Docker, or from source.
- [Configuration](/docs/mssql-mcp-go/configuration.md): Configure mssql-mcp-go with config.yaml or environment variables, and connect it to Claude Desktop, Cline, or Docker.
- [Tools](/docs/mssql-mcp-go/tools.md): All tools exposed by mssql-mcp-go, grouped by what they help you do.

#### postgres-mcp-go

- [postgres-mcp-go](/docs/postgres-mcp-go.md): A read-only Model Context Protocol server for PostgreSQL, written in Go, with 70+ tools for schema, data, performance, security, and migration analysis.
- [Installation](/docs/postgres-mcp-go/installation.md): Install postgres-mcp-go with Homebrew, a release binary, Docker, or from source.
- [Configuration](/docs/postgres-mcp-go/configuration.md): Configure postgres-mcp-go with config.yaml or environment variables, and connect it to Claude Desktop, Cline, or Docker.
- [Tools](/docs/postgres-mcp-go/tools.md): All tools exposed by postgres-mcp-go, grouped by what they help you do.

#### omniroute-operator

- [omniroute-operator](/docs/omniroute-operator.md): A Kubebuilder operator that deploys and manages OmniRoute — the unified AI proxy/router — on self-hosted Kubernetes.
- [Installation](/docs/omniroute-operator/installation.md): Install the omniroute-operator with Helm, then deploy an OmniRoute instance.
- [OmniRoute CR](/docs/omniroute-operator/omniroute-cr.md): Reference for the gateway.omniroute.ai/v1alpha1 OmniRoute custom resource.
- [Local development](/docs/omniroute-operator/local-development.md): Run the omniroute-operator against a local k3d cluster, build images, and run the controller outside Kubernetes.

### Other

- [Documentation for coding agents](/agents.md): A compact map of Nirantara's documentation, plus the details that are easiest to get wrong when generating configuration for k3sctl, the MCP servers, or the omniroute-operator.
